generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated palette-and-material clue for a character-gallery card
Primary request: create one soft cream short-pile plush material swatch whose ivory color and fine fibers match the fabric surface in Image 1. This must read as a fabric specimen, not a character.
Subject: a single rounded-square textile swatch, softly padded and slightly curved, with a folded corner exposing the plush edge and thickness.
Style/medium: premium soft 3D product illustration with fine, delicate fibers and refined edges.
Composition/framing: centered, fully visible, about 70% of the square canvas, similar isolated framing to Image 1.
Lighting/mood: warm gentle studio light, preserving creamy whites without yellow cast.
Color palette: pale warm ivory and cream matching the reference; restrained beige fiber shadows.
Materials/textures: very short dense velvety plush, soft rather than shaggy.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with alpha; no ground or cast shadow. No full character/body, sphere/orb, eyes, face, limbs, garment, accessories, lettering, logo, frame, or UI.
